Headline: "LangSmith: Agent & LLM Observability Platform"
Tagline: "Know what your agents are really doing"
Desc: "LangSmith Observability gives you complete visibility into agent behavior. Trace your
preferred framework or integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript,
Go, or Java SDKs."

Tracing: "See exactly what your agent is doing step by step. Pinpoint the issues hurting
latency, cost, and response quality." Native tracing for popular agent frameworks +
OpenTelemetry. Message threading for multi-turn chat.
Monitoring: "real-time view of how your agents are performing"; cost tracking; "Online
LLM-as-judge and code evals"; tool + agent trajectory monitoring; webhook + PagerDuty alerts.
Insights: "Automatically analyze and cluster your traces to detect usage patterns";
unsupervised topic clustering; error-analysis templates; executive summary with key findings.
SmithDB: "Purpose-built database for agent traces with sub-second performance"; JSON key-path
filtering + trajectory queries; self-hosting for data residency.

Integrations:
- Frameworks/libraries: LangChain, LangGraph, DeepAgents, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK,
  Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, OpenTelemetry
- SDKs: Python, TypeScript, Go, Java
- Infra: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Postgres, object storage

Customers: NO attributed quotes/metrics/case studies on the page. 25+ logos incl. Vanta,
Clay, Rippling, Lyft, Gong, Harvey, Abridge, Autodesk, Bristol Myers Squibb, Workday, Cisco,
Monday.com, Nvidia, Bridgewater, ServiceNow, Coinbase, Rakuten, Elastic, Uber, Zip.
